2. Introduction

2.1 Purpose

This SRS defines what the RegenEngine platform must do by the end of Phase 1 · Sprint 2 (the MVP). It is the shared reference for the AI Service team, the App team, QA (test cases are written from the acceptance criteria in week 1) and the customer (review and UAT sign-off).

2.2 Sprint goal

A founder goes from a submitted questionnaire to an AI report, unassisted.

Pipeline: Submit venture (Sprint 1) → Research → Analysis → Scoring → Report & charts. Also in the MVP: the Founder DNA Assessment (scored and reported), the Investor Assessment and partner portal, and admin for users, ventures, scoring weights and charts.

2.3 Exit criteria (D1.14)

  • 10 worked example ventures run end to end.
  • Unassisted live demo: account → report.
  • Full regression and UAT recorded and signed off.
  • The MVP runs on one fixed LLM (customer-agreed). 3-LLM orchestration follows in Sprint 3.

3. Definitions

TermDefinition
RegenScore / Venture ScoreThe venture's composite score (0–100) from the ten scored categories.
CategoryOne scored questionnaire section, A–J (A General, B Documents, C Team, D Problem–Solution, E Market, F SWOT, G Positioning, H Go-to-Market, I Financials, J IP & Moats).
Section KRegenerability & Impact. The proposal section: reported in the report, never scored, excluded from all charts.
WeightA category's share of the composite. By default, section points ÷ total scored points.
CompositeWeighted average of category scores, rounded to an integer.
Category floorMinimum category score for qualification. Default 65.
QualifiedComposite ≥ 75 and no category below 65.
Score bandsStrong ≥ 75 · Meets floor 65–74 · Below floor < 65.
Scoring modelA versioned set of weights, thresholds, rubrics and prompts. Exactly one is Active.
Founder DNASeparate assessment of the founder (8 traits, 0–100). Shown next to the Venture Score, never mixed into it.
VerdictResearch result for a claim: Supported, Partly supported, Not verifiable, Contradicted, Risk found.
ConfidenceHigh / Med / Low certainty attached to a finding or verdict.
Four-eyes ruleA second admin must approve sensitive actions and configuration publishes. Requesters cannot approve their own requests.
PartnerAn investor user of the Partner Portal (VC or Impact Investor in Sprint 2).
MLP-2Next release (December 2026) that opens matching and deal flow.
p9595th-percentile duration.

5. System overview

5.1 Portals

Three consoles share one application shell and design tokens: the Founders Portal (existing, with new Sprint 2 pages tagged SP2), the Partner Portal (investors) and the Admin Console (ARIIVL). Every Sprint 2 screen in the prototype carries a gold "SP2 · #nn" tag naming its plan tasks. Screens outside the plan carry a grey "Outside SP2 plan" or "MLP-2 · Dec 2026" tag.

5.2 Teams and boundary

The AI Service team builds the research, analysis and scoring engines, report generation and PDF, Founder DNA scoring/research and investor AI validation. The App team builds the score charts and report screens, Founder DNA UI, investor criteria model and portal, and the admin screens. The Tech Lead owns the API contract between them.

5.3 API contract (AI Service ↔ App)

InterfaceWhat it carries
Start assessmentSubmitted venture → AI analysis job
Job statusQueued, running, done, failed + progress for the waiting screen
ScoresCategory, weighted, composite 0–100, Qualified (≥ 75, no section < 65)
ReportSummary and detailed JSON, PDF signed URL
DNA & InvestorAnswers in → scores, findings with sources and confidence out
  • Schemas signed off by the Tech Lead: Wed 4 Nov.
  • AI team ships mock endpoints with fixture data (from the demo ventures): Fri 6 Nov.
  • App team builds on mocks in W1–W2. Switch to real APIs: Mon 16 Nov.
  • Any contract change goes through the Tech Lead, and both teams are told the same day.

5.4 End-to-end flow

  1. Section submit → section analysis (≤ 15 s) → section feedback.
  2. Final submit → Start assessment → consistency review → scoring (deterministic) → score v1 → RegenScore page.
  3. In parallel: research run (background) → Internet research tab.
  4. Report generation (≤ 45 s) → branded PDFs → encrypted storage → email to founder → Venture Report page.
  5. Any new score version (re-submit, model publish, override) → report regenerated as a new version.

6.1 AI Research Engine

Team: AI ServiceEffort: 12 MDTasks: #24 – #27

Module description

Runs on a single, customer-chosen LLM in the MVP and gathers external evidence about a submitted venture: market size and growth, competitors and SWOT threats, company registration, founder credentials and IP. Every claim it checks gets a verdict, a confidence level and numbered sources. Every run is stored so it can be audited and replayed. Founders see the output on the AI Feedback page; admins see it in AI Runs and Submission detail.

FeatureNamePortal / screenTasks
RES-01LLM provider layer and failoverBack end (visible in Run details and AI Runs)#24
RES-02Agentic research workflowsFounder › AI Feedback › Internet research#25
RES-03RAG grounding, attribution and confidenceFounder › AI Feedback; Admin › Submission › AI analysis#26
RES-04Audit trail, reproducibility and async jobsFounder › AI Feedback › Run details; Admin › AI Runs#27
RES-01

LLM provider layer and failover

SP2 · #24
Portal / screenBack end (visible in Run details and AI Runs)
ActorsSystem; Admin (read-only)

Feature description

One abstraction layer sits between the engines and the LLM vendor, so every engine (research, analysis, report, Founder DNA, investor validation) calls the same internal interface. The MVP runs on one fixed LLM agreed with the customer. Orchestrating three LLMs is Sprint 3 work.

User story. As the platform, I want all AI calls to go through one provider layer so that the vendor can be changed, rate limits can be handled and every call is recorded the same way.

Functional requirements

IDRequirement
RES-01.1All engines SHALL call the LLM through a single provider interface. Engine code SHALL NOT call a vendor SDK directly.
RES-01.2The provider, model and API key SHALL be set in configuration, not in code. The customer supplies the API account (kickoff input due Wed 4 Nov).
RES-01.3On a rate-limit (HTTP 429) or transient error the layer SHALL retry with exponential backoff (1 s, then 2 s), as shown in the run trail.
RES-01.4If a secondary provider is configured and retries are exhausted, the layer SHALL fail over to it with the same prompt and the same inputs, and record the run status as Failover.
RES-01.5Each call SHALL record the provider used, tokens, duration and final status (Completed, Retried ×n, Failover, Failed).

Business rules and notes

  • MVP = one fixed LLM. Whether a secondary provider is provisioned for failover in Sprint 2 is an open decision (see Open Issues OI-04).

UI mockup

Validation rules

Field / elementRuleError / feedback shownSource
Provider configProvider, model and key must be present at start-up. The service refuses to start without them.— (deployment check)Proposed — to confirm
Retry policyUp to 2 retries with backoff before failover or failureRun status Retried ×2 / FailoverPrototype

Acceptance criteria

AC-1the primary provider returns 429 twicean analysis run executesthe run retries with 1 s and 2 s backoff, then fails over to the secondary (if configured), completes, and the trail lists every attempt
AC-2no secondary provider is configuredretries are exhaustedthe run is marked Failed, the founder sees a retry-later state, and nothing partial is written to the score
RES-02

Agentic research workflows

SP2 · #25
Portal / screenFounder › AI Feedback › Internet research
ActorsSystem; Founder (reader); Admin (reader)

Feature description

After final submission, a background research run checks the venture's claims against public sources in three groups: Market size & growth, Competition & SWOT, and Entity & IP verification. It runs asynchronously and never blocks the score.

User story. As a founder, I want my main claims checked against live sources so that I know what an investor will be able to verify before I pitch.

Functional requirements

IDRequirement
RES-02.1The research run SHALL start automatically when the founder makes the final submission of the questionnaire (Start assessment API).
RES-02.2The run SHALL cover three claim groups: Market size & growth (TAM/SAM/SOM, growth), Competition & SWOT (competitor claims, threats, opportunities) and Entity & IP verification (company registry, founder credentials, patents, trademarks).
RES-02.3The run SHALL execute in the background. The Venture Score SHALL be shown without waiting for research to finish.
RES-02.4The Internet research tab SHALL show, for each group, a table with Claim, What the research found, Verdict and Confidence, plus the claim count per group.
RES-02.5The tab SHALL end with a numbered Sources list showing the retrieval date, each entry linking to its source.

Business rules and notes

  • Research is read-only for the founder. Correcting a claim means re-submitting the questionnaire.
  • Competitor names and sources in the prototype are sample data.

UI mockup

Validation rules

Field / elementRuleError / feedback shownSource
Claim rowMust carry a verdict and a confidence. A claim with no source can only be Not verifiable.—Prototype

Acceptance criteria

#GivenWhenThen
AC-1a founder has made the final submissionthe research run completesthe Internet research tab lists every checked claim under its group with a verdict, a confidence and source references, and the stat tile shows Claims researched, n supported and the source count
AC-2research is still runningthe founder opens RegenScorethe score and charts are shown. Research is not a precondition.
RES-03

RAG grounding, attribution and confidence

SP2 · #26
Portal / screenFounder › AI Feedback; Admin › Submission › AI analysis
ActorsSystem

Feature description

Research answers are grounded in retrieved documents. Every finding is attributed to numbered sources and gets one of five verdicts and one of three confidence levels.

User story. As an investor reading a report, I want every verified claim to show where it came from so that I can trust or check it.

Functional requirements

IDRequirement
RES-03.1Each researched claim SHALL have exactly one verdict: Supported, Partly supported, Not verifiable, Contradicted or Risk found.
RES-03.2Each claim SHALL have a confidence of High, Med or Low, shown as a three-bar indicator with its label (not by colour alone).
RES-03.3A claim with no retrieved source SHALL be shown as Not verifiable and SHALL NEVER be shown as Supported.
RES-03.4Source references SHALL appear inline as numbered chips ([1], [2]…) that resolve to the Sources list.
RES-03.5Verdict colours: Supported = green, Partly supported = amber, Contradicted / Risk found = red, Not verifiable = neutral.

Business rules and notes

  • Verdict and confidence are separate. A claim can be Contradicted with High confidence.

Validation rules

Field / elementRuleError / feedback shownSource
VerdictMust be one of the 5 enumerated values—Prototype
ConfidenceMust be one of High / Med / Low—Prototype
Supported without sourceRejected by the engine; stored as Not verifiable—Prototype

Acceptance criteria

#GivenWhenThen
AC-1the engine finds no public source for the claim 'SOM €18M by 2029'the result is storedthe claim shows Not verifiable, Low confidence and no source chip
RES-04

Audit trail, reproducibility and async jobs

SP2 · #27
Portal / screenFounder › AI Feedback › Run details; Admin › AI Runs
ActorsSystem; Admin

Feature description

Every research, analysis, scoring, report, Founder DNA and investor-validation run is recorded with its prompt or config version, provider, sources, tokens, time, status and input/output hashes. Any run can be replayed with the same inputs. Long runs execute as async jobs whose status the App polls.

User story. As an admin, I want to see and replay any AI run so that I can explain a score or a report to a founder, an investor or an auditor.

Functional requirements

IDRequirement
RES-04.1Each run SHALL store: Run ID (prefix by engine: RR research, AN analysis, SC scoring, RP report, DN Founder DNA, IV investor), engine, subject, prompt/config version, provider, source count, tokens, time and status.
RES-04.2Each run SHALL store an inputs hash and an output hash, and a timestamped trail (Queued, Started, retries, failover, Completed).
RES-04.3Admin › AI Runs SHALL list all runs with KPI tiles: Runs today (with failed count), p95 section analysis (target ≤ 15 s), p95 report (target ≤ 45 s), Failovers.
RES-04.4Clicking a run SHALL open a detail drawer with its metadata and trail, and a Replay run action.
RES-04.5Replay SHALL re-execute with the same inputs and report whether the output hash matches.
RES-04.6The Job status API SHALL return Queued, Running, Done or Failed plus progress, for the waiting screens.
RES-04.7Founder › AI Feedback › Run details SHALL show the founder's own last runs (max 5) in a read-only table.

Business rules and notes

  • Scoring runs are deterministic (provider = deterministic, no tokens).

ANL-01

Analysis orchestrator

SP2 · #28
Portal / screenBack end
ActorsSystem

Feature description

Coordinates the per-section analysis, the consistency review and the research run for one venture, and passes their outputs to the Scoring and Reporting engines.

User story. As the platform, I want one orchestrator to sequence analysis, research, scoring and reporting so that each venture moves through the pipeline predictably.

Functional requirements

IDRequirement
ANL-01.1On each section submit the orchestrator SHALL queue a section analysis job for that section.
ANL-01.2On final submission it SHALL queue, in order: consistency review → scoring → report generation, and in parallel the research run.
ANL-01.3A failed step SHALL be retried per RES-01. A step that still fails SHALL NOT block steps that do not depend on it. Research failure does not block scoring.
ANL-01.4When a later research result changes evidence, the orchestrator SHALL trigger report regeneration (RPT-04).

Acceptance criteria

#GivenWhenThen
AC-1a founder submits the final sectionthe orchestrator runsa scoring job and a research job are created. The score is available before research finishes.

SCR-01

Configurable scoring framework

SP2 · #33
Portal / screenFounder › RegenScore
ActorsFounder; System

Feature description

Ten categories map 1:1 to questionnaire sections A–J. Section K (Regenerability & Impact) is reported but never scored. Weights come from each section's assessment points in Appendix A v4.

User story. As a founder, I want one clear score with the rule for qualifying so that I know how far I am from being investor-ready.

Functional requirements

IDRequirement
SCR-01.1Category weight SHALL equal section points ÷ total points of scored sections × 100, unless overridden by the active scoring model.
SCR-01.2Composite SHALL equal Σ(weightᵢ × scoreᵢ) ÷ Σ weightᵢ, rounded to the nearest integer, on a 0–100 scale.
SCR-01.3Qualified SHALL be true only when composite ≥ 75 AND no category < 65. Both rules must hold.
SCR-01.4The RegenScore page SHALL show: the composite (n / 100), the Qualified / Not yet qualified badge, a plain-language explanation of the gap (points short, categories under the floor), version, date, model, and actions Open report and Score history.
SCR-01.5A Score breakdown table SHALL list Category, Weight, Score, Contribution (score × weight ÷ 100) and Status (Strong ≥ 75, Meets floor 65–74, Below 65), plus K as 'Proposal · not scored' and a Composite row.
SCR-01.6A Fix first card SHALL list every category below 65 plus the lowest category above it, with points needed and weight, linking to the Action Plan.
SCR-01.7Identical answers on the same model SHALL always give identical scores.

Business rules and notes

  • Phase 1 computes the Venture Score. The Founder DNA score (F2.2) is shown next to it and never mixed into it.
  • Before final submission the RegenScore page keeps its Sprint 1 locked state.

SCR-03

Admin scoring controls (Scoring Model Management)

SP2 · #33 #34 #35
Portal / screenAdmin › Configuration › Scoring Model
ActorsSuper-admin; Lead Analyst (draft edit); second admin (approval)

Feature description

Versioned scoring models with category weights, thresholds, per-category rubrics, scoring prompts and an A/B test against the reference ventures. Only a Draft can be edited. Publishing needs a second admin, takes effect on a chosen date without a redeploy and can re-score ventures.

User story. As an ARIIVL admin, I want to tune weights and thresholds safely so that the score reflects our investment judgement without asking the dev team.

Functional requirements

IDRequirement
SCR-03.1The Versions list SHALL show each model's version, status (Active / Draft / Archived), name and date. Exactly one model SHALL be Active.
SCR-03.2New version SHALL create a Draft copied from the Active model. Roll back to this (on an Archived model) SHALL create a new Draft copied from it.
SCR-03.3Weights SHALL be edited by sliders (0–25 %, step 0.5), with the delta against Active shown per category. K SHALL be shown locked: 'Reported, never scored'.
SCR-03.4Thresholds SHALL be editable in a Draft by sliders (40–95): Qualified composite, Qualified category floor, IC threshold, Invest threshold.
SCR-03.5Rubric & prompts: per-category rubric text and the scoring prompt SHALL be editable in a Draft and read-only otherwise.
SCR-03.6A/B test SHALL compare Active vs the selected version on the 10 reference ventures (and shadow-scored ventures): Avg score, % Qualified, % Disagreement with the analyst call, and a per-venture table flagging 'Becomes qualified' / 'Loses qualified'.
SCR-03.7Publish SHALL open a dialog: Effective from (date), Re-score (All scored ventures / New submissions only) and Change summary. It SHALL send a request to Approvals and SHALL NOT activate the model directly.
SCR-03.8On the effective date an approved model SHALL become Active without a redeploy, and re-scored ventures SHALL get new score versions.

Business rules and notes

  • IC and Invest thresholds come from the Admin Console proposal and are outside the Sprint 2 plan (OI-03).
  • The proposal's 6-pillar model was replaced by the plan's 10 categories (OI-01).

INV-03.3Sectors, Stage and Impact mandates (SDGs) SHALL be multi-select chips, shared with onboarding.
INV-03.4A Live matches preview SHALL show the number of opportunities matching the current thesis.
INV-03.5Save thesis SHALL validate and save. Changes apply from the next match refresh, and past matches keep their fit score.

Business rules and notes

  • The proposal weights 6 pillars. The screen uses the plan's 10 categories so investors weight the same score founders receive (OI-02).

Feature description

Manage internal analysts, IC members, founders and partners. Assign role-based permissions under least privilege.

User story. As a super-admin, I want to control who can do what so that sensitive actions are limited to the right people.

Functional requirements

IDRequirement
ADM-01.1Users tab SHALL list User (name, email), Type (Internal / Founder / Partner), Role, Status (Active / Inactive / Invited), Last seen and actions.
ADM-01.2Internal users' role SHALL be changeable inline (Super-admin, Lead Analyst, Analyst, IC Member, Read-only). Founders and partners show a fixed role.
ADM-01.3Deactivate SHALL set the user Inactive and sign them out everywhere. Reactivate restores Active.
ADM-01.4Delete SHALL open a confirmation with Reason and create an approval request. Nothing is deleted until a second admin approves.
ADM-01.5Invite user SHALL take Email, Type (Internal / Partner) and Role, and send an email to set a password and turn on two-factor sign-in.
ADM-01.6Roles & permissions tab SHALL show the permission matrix (see the Roles section of this document).
ADM-01.7An admin SHALL NOT change their own role, deactivate or delete themselves (row shows 'You').
ADM-01.8Role changes, deactivation, invitations and deletion requests SHALL be audit-logged.

Business rules and notes

  • Founders and partners sign in to their own portals and have no admin permissions.

Submission intake, queue and detail (with score override)

Feature description

All submitted ventures in one queue with search, filters, a score band, bulk status / analyst changes and CSV export, plus a detail page with Overview, RegenScore (with override), AI analysis, Documents and Activity.

User story. As an analyst, I want to filter and act on submissions in bulk and open any venture's full assessment so that I can triage the pipeline quickly.

Functional requirements

IDRequirement
ADM-02.1Filters: Search (venture, founder or ID), Sector, Stage, Status, RegenScore band (slider 0–100, shows 'n–100'). The footer shows 'Showing x of y'.
ADM-02.2Table columns: select, Venture (link + ID), Founder, Sector, Stage, Country, Score (badge; low if < 65), Status, Submitted.
ADM-02.3Selecting rows SHALL show a bulk bar: n selected, Move to status…, Assign analyst…, Apply, Clear.
ADM-02.4Statuses: New, Triaged, In Review, IC, Invested, Passed, Hold.
ADM-02.5Export SHALL produce CSV with personal data masked according to the user's role.
ADM-02.6Detail header: venture, ID · founder · sector · stage · country, score badge, status, lead analyst, Assign analyst and Status selects.
ADM-02.7Overview tab: AI triage rationale with confidence, Verification checklist (KYC, company registry, cap table vs answers, IP ownership), Key facts.
ADM-02.8RegenScore tab: radar + breakdown table + 'Override a score'. An override takes Category, New score and a required Reason, creates a new score version, is audit-logged, and the founder sees the new score.
ADM-02.9AI analysis tab: consistency review and research highlights. Documents tab: uploaded files with section code, upload date, AI parse status, View. Activity tab: audit entries for this submission, or empty state.
ADM-02.10Every status change, assignment and override SHALL be audit-logged with a before → after diff.

Business rules and notes

  • Submission detail is not in the Admin Console proposal; it is added so that venture names link somewhere.
  • AI triage, Deals and Deal room are outside the Sprint 2 plan.

ADM-03

Questionnaire management

SP2 · Decision 14 Oct 2026 (D1.12)
Portal / screenAdmin › Configuration › Questionnaire
ActorsSuper-admin; Lead Analyst (draft); second admin (approval)

Feature description

The questionnaire structure is fixed with the customer: 11 sections A–K in a set order (Appendix A v4). Inside it, admins change wording, guidance, options, required/optional, points, whether a question is scored, and conditional visibility, without code.

User story. As ARIIVL, I want to change questions myself within the agreed structure so that every wording change does not need a dev ticket.

Functional requirements

IDRequirement
ADM-03.1A banner SHALL show the published version (v4.0, Appendix A v4, effective date) and the draft (v4.1) with its change count.
ADM-03.2The section list SHALL show A–K with question counts. Section order and count are locked.
ADM-03.3The question table SHALL show position (locked), Code, Question (label + text preview), Type, Points, Required, Edit, with the section's question count, points and 'not scored' if applicable.
ADM-03.4Edit SHALL open a drawer: Label, Question, Guidance (optional), Answer type (limited to types allowed by the structure), Points (section total updates live), Options (for single/multi select: edit, delete, add), Required toggle, Counts toward the score toggle, Show only when (question · is / is not · value).
ADM-03.5Save to draft SHALL record the change in draft v4.1 and the audit log. Code and position cannot change.
ADM-03.6Submit draft for approval SHALL create an approval request. It is rejected if the draft has no changes.
ADM-03.7Founders SHALL keep the questionnaire version they started on. New starts get the published version.
ADM-03.8Changing points SHALL change category weights only through a scoring model (SCR-03). A points change is flagged for the scoring admin.

Business rules and notes

  • Content changes from the customer (like moving to v4) are change requests, not in-sprint fixes (kickoff rule).
  • Answer types available: Group of fields, Single select, Multi select, Long text, URL (plus those defined in v4).
